headline: Core earnings climb strongly; guidance reaffirmed
summary_short: Core EPS was $0.98 versus $0.83 a year ago and GAAP EPS was $0.96 versus $0.76. FirstEnergy reaffirmed 2026 Core EPS guidance of $2.62-$2.82 and expects results at or slightly above the midpoint.
summary_long: Revenue rose to $4.6B from $4.1B. Year-to-date Core EPS is $2.20, up 9% from $2.02. The company deployed $4.9B of its $36B five-year Energize365 capital plan in the first nine months and sees Core EPS growth near the top of 6%-8% through 2030. It secured Siemens turbines for the proposed Maidsville Energy Center in West Virginia, with a state order expected in Q4 2026.
confidence_notes: Core earnings is a non-GAAP measure excluding special items. Deltas computed from prior-year figures stated in the release ($0.83 Core, $0.76 GAAP, $441M net income, $4.1B revenue; revenue delta uses rounded figures).

drivers.explanation: The release attributes results to continued implementation of its investment strategy, financial discipline and improved operations across the service territory.
CEO says strong execution supports the long-term outlook and positions the company for its next phase of growth.
